briefing.opening: Good morning/afternoon. I will now begin the climate briefing for August 24, 2026.

sections.title: 🔴 Unprecedented Spread of Climate Crisis and Social Impacts
sections.content: According to news released today, global ocean temperatures have reached record highs due to climate change and El Niño, with the daily global sea surface temperature in 2024 already breaking records [29, 39, 52, 60, 64, 67]. These unprecedented heatwaves are reshaping daily life in various cities and towns across Europe, and some European public opinion has shifted to perceive air conditioner distribution as more urgent than climate action [1, 31, 41, 43, 44, 46, 50, 51, 53, 54, 58, 59, 61, 62, 63]. Furthermore, climate change is directly impacting human health, leading to casualties, such as deaths due to heatwave isolation in California's Death Valley [42, 66]. In the United States, major summer music festivals have even been canceled due to climate change [40], and the wildfire crisis in the Northwest and Nevada regions is also linked to climate change [33, 68]. Amid increasing climate change concerns among Connecticut residents [34], a discrepancy between this rapidly changing climate reality and political rhetoric has been pointed out, with some even raising controversy over climate change itself [69, 70, 32].

sections.title: ⚠️ Realistic Challenges and Tasks for Carbon Neutrality Policies
sections.content: Domestically, criticism has been raised that the revised Carbon Neutrality Act is trapped in socioeconomic 'inertia,' making it difficult to achieve practical goals [6, 9, 11]. In particular, mega-projects are facing an 'energy dilemma,' undermining carbon neutrality goals, and the energy transition of industrial complexes has emerged as an urgent task amidst intensifying demands for carbon neutrality [13, 14]. Environmental civic groups are advocating for the adjustment of electricity demand forecasts in the Basic Plan for Long-term Electricity Supply and Demand (Jeongibon) to achieve renewable energy transition targets, pointing out the gap between political will and reality [26]. Internationally, news has emerged that climate change-related lawsuits against fossil fuel companies have become easier [28], and in the UK, controversy over the legitimacy of approving oil field development in the North Atlantic and North Sea highlights the dilemma between energy security and climate crisis response [71]. These situations suggest that the path towards carbon neutrality goals is not smooth, and political determination and social consensus are becoming even more crucial.

sections.title: 🌱 Efforts to Expand Renewable Energy and Practice Carbon Neutrality
sections.content: On a positive note, various efforts to expand renewable energy are continuing domestically. Nexen Tire has signed a Power Purchase Agreement (PPA) with SK Innovation E&S for the renewable energy transition of its factories, expanding the use of renewable energy at its Yangsan and Changnyeong plants [21, 24]. Changes in power facility design standards are also being announced to align with the era of AI and renewable energy [22]. In Sinan County, 'Sunlight Income Villages' have been selected to promote resident-led renewable energy expansion, and resident-participatory projects have been fully launched [25, 27]. Incoard has also released 'New & Renewable Energy Grid Map,' a platform for reviewing renewable energy projects, contributing to the revitalization of the related industry [23]. Citizen participation in practicing carbon neutrality is also active. In the Chungnam region, a social solidarity economy model combining litter-picking activities with carbon neutrality is spreading [16, 20], and the submission period for an environmental love contest encouraging future generations to practice carbon neutrality has also been extended [17]. Furthermore, the Small Enterprise and Market Promotion Agency (SEMAS) has been recognized for its carbon neutrality efforts, winning the 'Carbon Neutrality and Eco-Friendly Sector' at the ESG Management Awards and receiving the '2026 Sustainable ESG Management Award' [8, 18]. Local government-level carbon neutrality research and educational activities are also active, with the Yongin Special City Council launching 'Carbon Neutrality Research Institute IV' and the Yeoncheon County Carbon Neutrality Support Center operating a DMZ ecological exploration program [10, 15].

sections.title: 🌍 Climate Change Adaptation and International Cooperation Efforts
sections.content: Domestically, efforts in the agricultural sector for climate change adaptation are notable. In Yangpyeong County, technical training for cultivating subtropical crops has commenced to respond to climate change and prepare for future agriculture, exploring changes in the agricultural sector [2, 5]. Internationally, research on the social impacts of climate change continues, highlighting complex relationships with various social issues, such as the link between climate change and child abuse [30]. Furthermore, grassroots international efforts are ongoing, such as discussions on climate change response strategies centered on community voices at the Harlem Week Climate Change Conference [36]. On a political level, a movement has been observed where the French left is uniting around climate action ahead of the 2027 French presidential election [56]. Australia is also facing increasing pressure regarding climate finance and international cooperation, being put to the test at COP31 to demand new climate finance commitments and transparent accounting [55]. Municipalities in Manitoba, Canada, are developing plans for climate change after severe weather events [57]. This demonstrates that climate change is a complex challenge extending beyond a simple environmental issue, encompassing social, economic, and political aspects, emphasizing the necessity of continuous cooperation and adaptation efforts from national governments and the international community.

briefing.closing: As discussed in today's briefing, an unprecedented climate crisis is spreading globally, and the importance of policy and social responses to it is growing. At the same time, positive efforts for renewable energy transition and carbon neutrality are continuing, offering hope for overcoming the climate crisis. This concludes today's climate briefing.

summary.phenomenon: The UK government must soon decide whether to approve two oil and gas fields, Rosebank in the North Atlantic and Jackdaw in the North Sea. This decision comes amidst energy supply insecurity and deadly evidence of the climate crisis.
summary.outlook: If Carbon Capture and Storage (CCS) technology is applied, the Rosebank oil field could be compatible with the UK's net-zero commitments, provided its owners are willing to bear the cost.
